incident-bot: PagerDuty ALERT fired — PD-7890. HIGH latency on inference-frontend-us-west2 (route: /v1/generate). 90p=1.2s > 500ms threshold. Escalation: primary on-call.

emma (oncall): Acked, I'm looking :raised_hand:

emma (oncall): Quick check — dashboards show a ~1min spike starting ~30s ago, concurrent requests up ~2.5x. Error rate stable at 0.0%. No obvious 5xxs. https://dash.redwood.ai/boards/latency?range=5m

josh (sre): Seeing autoscaler activity around the same time. A couple of new gpu pods spun up and we had warmup CPU/IO on model-proxy-03. Logs show kv-cache misses during warmup.

maria (eng): We had a scheduled perf-test (canary) that inadvertently targeted us-west2 at the same minute — tag: perf-test/us-west2. That would explain the burst.

emma (oncall): If it's just a canary collision and no 5xxs, low customer impact. I'll keep the page but switch routing fallback to smaller-model variant for us-west2 to shave tail latency for the moment.

emma (oncall): routed traffic -> model-small-1 in us-west2 (temporary). Will watch.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty update — PD-7890 auto-resolved. All metrics below threshold. Resolution: 00:02:11. Incident notes: transient spike, likely canary load. No escalation required.

emma (oncall): Thanks. Confirming no customer-facing errors. Marking as NO_IMPACT for now. @maria please disable today's perf-test window or retarget to staging.

maria (eng): On it — disabling the perf-test in us-west2 now. Sorry for the noisy page :sheep:

josh (sre): I'll add a short-term autoscaler cooldown tweak and a note in the runbook to avoid paging on tagged perf-tests. Created PR: https://git.redwood.ai/runbooks/pull/123

emma (oncall): Good. We'll close this thread but leave a follow-up — if we get repeats we'll open a postmortem. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
